Celebrations

Vegetable bar cake

Zöldséges torta

10 months+ Sound idea 50 min 6 portions

A savoury celebration plate from 10 months. Cut bars the child can hold, and skip any cheese that tastes salty.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 2 medium potato (baked until soft)
  • 1 large carrot (roasted or baked until soft)
  • 60 g spinach (wilted; a layer, not a huge daily bowl)
  • 20 g mild pasteurized cheese (not feta, halloumi, blue, or a hard salty cheese)
  • 1 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (to stop the vegetables sticking)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Bake the potato and carrot until soft, and wilt the spinach.
  2. Slice the potato and carrot.
  3. Oil a small dish and layer potato, carrot, and spinach.
  4. Scatter the mild cheese over the top.
  5. Bake until the vegetables are hot and the cheese is just soft.
  6. Cool slightly and cut into bars.

Sound idea

Salty cheese is the thing that would make this plate unsuitable.

Layer baked potato, roasted carrot, and spinach with a little mild cheese, then cut the bake into bars. Use no salty cheese.
